Expert guidance for Python in n8n Code nodes (Python mode).

Use JavaScript for 95% of use cases. Use Python only for complex Python-specific logic, standard-library features, existing Python logic, or team preference. Python in n8n has **NO external libraries**. Available standard library: `json`, `datetime`, `re`, `base64`, `hashlib`, `urllib.parse`, `math`, `random`, `statistics`.

Configure Code node mode: All Items or Each Item.

Must return `[{"json": {...}}]`
Do not return `return {"result": "success"}`.

Prevent `ModuleNotFoundError`, empty code/missing return, `KeyError`, `IndexError`, and incorrect return format.
Use .get() for dictionaries. Check lengths before indexing. Always
